description: A2 (c220) KDA decode / speculative decode (T <= 16): state resident in UB, two row passes per token. Re-authored from this repository's A5 kda_fused_recurrent for the A2 facade (tile-vector ops, no @vf). Reads the public token-major BF16/FP32 tensors directly; casts, scale and the GQA head map are in-kernel.

domain.block_dim_note: Only 1 and 2 have been run on the A2 device; the A5 list (up to 28) is not inherited.
domain.gate_span: no chunk-span limit: each token uses exp(g) of that token only

default.reason: final_state is FP32 end to end; the A5 decode budget is kept (A2 kernel measured 4e-8..1e-7 on device).

o.reason: o is written in BF16 (D-PM-35); its floor is the BF16 rounding of the FP32 result, measured 1.63e-3..1.71e-3 relative L2. The budget is about 3x that floor, fixed before the unit runs.

support.scope: All 8 contract cases (A2-03, pin library 90cfcdc / kernels b3b3f9c); evidence/unit/<stage>.json.

support.note: AGENTS.md section 2 / A2-11 premises: (1) current compatibility pins library90cfcdc720bbcd66e8bd4361c4dd4fbc1a2a57b5 and kernelsb3b3f9c16df7c4626ed3c081032a1be5a753d0b1, actual imported library bytes verified; Ascend910B3 / CANN9.0.0 compiler+OPP timestamp20260428_134817545, built-in ascend910b/ascend910_93 recorded in each native receipt. (2) Fresh full A2 static accumulate guard tests passed. (3) FP32 split-K barrier repair is present in the selected library pin and established by A2-11; this vector-only decode does not invoke it. (4) Fresh AST scan of kernels/step.py finds zero matmul calls, so neither BF16/FP16 split-K nor a handwritten FP32 MMAD chain is exercised; no claim that the hardware defects disappeared. The companion chunk path retains its explicit barriers and passed the fresh continuation workload. Primary golden is independent Torch CPU FP32; Torch NPU FP32 is the second oracle; existing FP64-internal unit reference is retained as an additional diagnostic. Budgets, ABI and domain unchanged.

changes: No @vf on A2: one tile-vector op per state row, per-row scalars via Var.GetValueFrom, A5 accumulation order.
Public token-major BF16 q/k/v and FP32 g/beta read directly (2-D GM views); the A5 host-side fp32 cast, BHV permute, GQA repeat and scale pre-multiply are gone.
o written in BF16 with a round-to-nearest-even cast.
